$comment: Generation recipe for this episode's artwork. The ENGINE never reads this file — only scripts/generate-assets.mjs does, and only when someone runs it. The render reads the PNGs it produced, on disk, like any other episode's.
style: 1969 documentary photograph, shot on 35mm film, muted desaturated colour, heavy film grain, natural available light, period-accurate Northern California, no text, no captions, no watermark, no modern objects
$styleAlpha: For cut-outs only. No film grain and no 1969 available light here: those describe a ROOM, and a room has no backdrop to key away. The period treatment is applied to the whole frame at render time by FilmLook. What this needs is a clean studio shot with an empty backdrop.
styleAlpha: sharp studio photograph, even soft frontal lighting, period-accurate 1969 clothing
negative: text, letters, words, watermark, logo, cartoon, cgi, extra people, duplicate
